notes: The central story mechanic is Pete stepping in puddles of strawberries, blueberries, mud, and water, changing his shoes colour each time — the colours red, blue, brown, and wet are all story-critical and worth including as fringe. The repeated refrain 'I love my shoes' and Pete singing throughout make 'sing' and 'shoes' high-priority. 'Goodness' from the existing aac_extras is Pete's mild exclamation and is already covered. Colours white, red, blue, and brown map directly to the four shoe states in the book. The existing activity_images (shoes, puddle, strawberries, mud, bucket) and aac_extras (walk, sing, cool, goodness, squish) align well — all fringe choices here prioritise the most visually concrete and story-central vocabulary.
